//: STARTING POINT, NOT AUTO-APPLIED. GitHub does not read this file
automatically the way it reads .github/workflows/*.yml or
dependabot.yml - a human must actually apply this via the API or the
repo Settings UI (Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> New branch ruleset,
or `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/rulesets --input this-file` after
removing this comment key, since GitHub's API is strict about unknown
fields). This is Review Gate finding 7 (remediation cycle 1): a red
GitHub Actions run does NOT by itself block a merge - only a
ruleset/branch-protection rule requiring these exact checks does.
See .spark/pr-draft.md's manual-steps checklist for the human action
this file exists to support.
The required_status_checks contexts below are the exact `name:`
strings from .github/workflows/ci.yml as of the M0 remediation-cycle-1
commit that added this file - keep them in sync if job names change.
posthog-funnel-merge-test is DELIBERATELY excluded: it only runs on
push to main (if: github.event_name == 'push'), so it never reports
on a pull_request event - requiring it would make every PR wait
forever for a check that structurally cannot run against it.
No pull_request/human-approval rule is included on purpose (founder
decision during GATE 3 manual testing, 2026-08-28): this two-founder
team relies on the automated spark-review-gate audit before code
reaches a PR, and GitHub disallows self-approval, so a required
human-approval rule would block solo merges without adding a second
reviewer to the workflow. Revisit if a real second reviewer joins.
name: Require CI checks on main
